question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers_yearmonth AS T2
JOIN customers_yearmonth AS T1 ON T2.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
